management: Limit at CE, stop with one tick of slip, half off at T1 then breakeven, runner to T2, ties lose, flatten after 32 bars.
searched: 57 cuts with at least 110 trades. Best win rate 40.1% (Tuesday, stop between 0.7 and 1.2 ATR, 152 trades, +0.13R).
note: These are the desk's filled cards, split by person. None reached 65%. The search did not either.
